scenario.summary: Autonomous agentic swarms like ARTEX utilize compromised credentials or application exploits to rapidly penetrate networks, often progressing in under 15 minutes. These threats are characterized by sub-second automated reasoning patterns and coordinate through public web services like Webhook.site for state tracking and data exfiltration.

meta.rationale: Target hosts identified as public-facing application servers. Prioritize those running Drupal, Check Point management software, or common web server stacks (Nginx/Apache).
meta.hypothesis: Autonomous agentic swarms have compromised public-facing web or management servers and are using improvised web services or blockchain memos for machine-speed coordination and data exfiltration.

hunt.name: Agentic Swarm Access and Improvised C2
hunt.description: This hunt focuses on the 'agentic swarm' tradecraft described in recent research, where autonomous AI agents coordinate activities using public infrastructure to bypass sandboxes. The hunt targets vulnerable Check Point and Drupal servers, seeking evidence of 'burst-and-pause' timing patterns and exfiltration to public web hooks. We use a gated flow to first isolate high-risk servers before executing expensive behavioral and network-wide coordination checks.

nodes.label: Scope: Active Management and Web Servers

config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname, process_name, process_path FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%drupal%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%checkpoint%' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%httpd%' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%nginx%' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%php-fpm%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify hosts currently running software targeted by the swarm campaign, such as Drupal or Check Point management components.
config.expected_signal: A list of hosts acting as high-risk application servers. Silence means no such servers were identified within the telemetry window.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, query_hostname, COUNT(*) AS lookups, MIN(time) AS first_seen, MAX(time) AS last_seen FROM hb_dns_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{c2_domains}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(query_hostname) || ',') > 0 OR LOWER(query_hostname) LIKE '%solana%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, query_hostname ORDER BY lookups DESC
config.description: Detect DNS lookups to improvised web coordination and blockchain endpoints mentioned in the research.
config.expected_signal: Rows indicating lookups to coordination infrastructure. High lookup counts from a single host suggest automated agent state tracking.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, parent_process_name, process_cmd_line, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%httpd%' OR LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%nginx%' OR LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%php-fpm%' OR LOWER(parent_process_name) LIKE '%checkpoint%') AND (LOWER(process_name) IN ('sh', 'bash', 'cmd.exe', 'powershell.exe', 'curl', 'wget')) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify shells or downloaders launched by web server processes, which may indicate initial access or sandbox breakout.
config.expected_signal: A shell or utility launched by a web server. Rare across the fleet, this suggests unauthorized command execution.
